committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects licensed pharmacists, licensed physicians who compound drugs, and patients receiving compounded medications across state lines.
dimensions.evidence: Each licensed pharmacist or licensed physician who compounds drug products under this section and sends such drug products... out of the State

dimensions.assessment: Requires compliance with new annual reporting of interstate compounding volume, adverse event reporting, and specific product labeling mandates.
dimensions.evidence: the label of such drug product includes-- (i) the statement: 'This medication has been compounded for dispensing to an individual patients and has not been approved by the Food and Drug Administration.'

dimensions.assessment: Establishes administrative reporting systems and information sharing, but does not state specific appropriations or federal spending figures.
Amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act by adding federal requirements for adverse event reporting, annual volume reports, and specific drug labeling.
dimensions.evidence: Section 503A(b)(3) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act... is amended... by inserting after subparagraph (B) the following: (C) the label of such drug product includes

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory requirements for drug labeling and annual reporting.

missing_information: Specific economic or federal budgetary cost estimates for implementing the information sharing system and processing reports.
importance_detail.rationale: Imposes new reporting, adverse event disclosure, and labeling requirements on pharmacists and physicians who compound certain drug products and send them across state lines.
